title: KOR-BENCH: BENCHMARKING LANGUAGE MODELS ON KNOWLEDGE-ORTHOGONAL REASONING TASKS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating reasoning capabilities through five task categories: Operation, Logic, Cipher, Puzzle, and Counterfactual. While it contains a brief 'Ethics' section regarding dataset construction, it does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, or ethics.
